data.title: Free Week: Claim the Treasures of Tortuga From Feb 26 - March 4!
data.content:
Experience the full Early Access version of War Robots: Frontiers for one week from February 26 until March 4! Get started by downloading the game via MY.GAMES Launcher or the Steam Demo Version and play for free, no Pioneer Pack required.

Treasures Of Tortuga

Claim the treasures of Tortuga and put together a ferocious Fenrir build simply by logging in to War Robots: Frontiers every day from February 26 to March 3:

  • Day 1: Fenrir Chassis
  • Day 2: Fenrir Shoulders
  • Day 3: Fenrir Torso
  • Day 4: 3x Shocktrain Weapons
  • Day 5: 1x Regenerate Armour Ability
  • Day 6: 120x Intel
  • Day 7: Pilot (Idy Demorest)

IMPORTANT: Any progress made and prizes earned during the Free Week will be retained if you purchase a Pioneer Pack or win Early Access, but are subject to progress wipes in the future.

Subscribe to the official War Robots: Frontiers newsletter to get the latest news straight to your inbox, and follow the game on Twitter, Facebook, and Steam.
